title: Security: supply chain RCE via pull_request_target in eval-pr.yml (fork code executes with GEMINI_API_KEY)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report clearly identifies a security vulnerability in .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml where pull_request_target is used alongside checkout and execution of untrusted fork code with repository secrets.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Restructuring .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml to decouple untrusted fork code execution from privileged actions requires splitting workflow triggers into pull_request and workflow_run, managing artifact passing, and updating comment posting mechanics.

summary.problem: The workflow .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml uses pull_request_target and executes fork code with access to repository secrets like GEMINI_API_KEY.
summary.root_cause: The pull_request_target trigger runs in the context of the base repository with secrets enabled; checking out and building/executing PR head code from a fork allows untrusted code to read repository secrets.
summary.context: To mitigate supply chain code execution risks, untrusted PR code must run under a pull_request trigger without secrets, and privileged operations must be separated into a workflow_run workflow.

steps: Refactor .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml to use the pull_request event trigger instead of pull_request_target for untrusted code execution.
Remove GEMINI_API_KEY secret injection from steps running untrusted PR head code.
Separate privileged PR commenting and secret access into a workflow_run workflow triggered on completion of the pull_request workflow.
Upload evaluation result artifacts from the pull_request workflow and download them in the workflow_run workflow to post comments safely.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Fork pull requests execute PR evaluation steps without access to GEMINI_API_KEY or repository write permissions, and evaluation reports are safely posted via a workflow_run workflow.
verification_steps: Validate YAML syntax of the modified GitHub Actions workflow files.
Verify that pull_request event triggers without repository secrets for external fork PRs.
Verify that workflow_run triggers upon completion to download evaluation artifacts and post PR comments.
